name: Seedance 2.5 Reference To Video
description: Seedance 2.5 Reference To Video: generate, edit, or extend video guided by reference images, videos, and audio; editing and extension are requested through the prompt. Billed per million video output tokens; the rate depends on whether the input includes video.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Video length in seconds (4-30), or 'auto' to let the model choose.
duration.title: Duration

generate_audio.description: Whether to generate audio for the video.
generate_audio.title: Generate Audio

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the output video.
watermark.title: Watermark

bitrate_mode.description: Output encode bitrate. 'high' produces a larger, higher-bitrate file; defaults to 'standard'.
bitrate_mode.title: Bitrate Mode

ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. A video edit or extension keeps the source video's shape and accepts only 'adaptive' (or no ratio).
ratio.title: Ratio

image_urls.description: Up to 30 reference images (referenced in the prompt as @Image1...).
image_urls.title: Image Urls

video_urls.description: Up to 10 reference videos (referenced in the prompt as @Video1...). Each must be mp4 or mov, 2-30 seconds long, at most 200 MB, 24-60 fps, with a frame between 407,696 and 8,295,044 pixels (854x480 through roughly 4K); the reference videos total at most 30 seconds. Editing or extending a video is requested through the prompt (e.g. 'edit @Video1: ...', 'extend @Video1 ...'); both keep the source ratio (ratio 'adaptive' or omitted), and editing also keeps its length (duration 'auto').
video_urls.title: Video Urls

audio_urls.description: Up to 10 reference audio clips (referenced in the prompt as @Audio1...). Each must be wav or mp3, 2-30 seconds long, at most 15 MB; the clips total at most 30 seconds.
audio_urls.title: Audio Urls

omni_reference_task_type.description: How the reference task is treated. 'auto' (default) lets the model classify the task from the prompt after the job is queued. An explicit 'edit' requires at least one reference video, duration 'auto', and an adaptive (or omitted) ratio; an explicit 'extend' requires at least one reference video and an adaptive (or omitted) ratio, with a numeric duration setting the continuation length; 'reference' is unconstrained and forwards ratio and duration as given.
omni_reference_task_type.title: Omni Reference Task Type
